svg.aria-label: The verdict of every pre-registered measure and of stall time against three rivals, on the real model, on the conference task, with five coordinator crashes and half the agents killed, over ten seeds. Preserved work, calls in flight at a crash, still used. In-process: win, Realistic durable: tie, Ideal durable: tie. Extra cost, against no failures, same seed. In-process: win, Realistic durable: tie, Ideal durable: tie. Time to recover, from a crash to the first decision. In-process: tie, Realistic durable: tie, Ideal durable: tie. Coordinator-dependency time, work held up by a down coordinator. In-process: win, Realistic durable: win, Ideal durable: tie. Blast radius, share of agents and goals held up. In-process: win, Realistic durable: win, Ideal durable: tie. Idle agent-seconds, agents idle while ready work waits. In-process: tie, Realistic durable: tie, Ideal durable: tie. Unnecessary reassignments, re-sent while the assignee was alive. In-process: tie, Realistic durable: loss, Ideal durable: loss. Duplicated spend, calls already answered, paid again. In-process: win, Realistic durable: tie, Ideal durable: tie. Stall time, no agent call in flight anywhere. In-process: win, Realistic durable: tie, Ideal durable: tie. A tie unless every seed agrees and the difference reaches the minimum effect, by the rules of bench/PREREG.md. Coordinator-dependency time and blast radius are per crash; stall time is reported, not a hypothesis. The swarm's unnecessary reassignments are its false deaths. Most of the gap to the in-process supervisor comes from that rival's design, so it is no evidence against a well-built supervisor.
